verdict.rationale: Entra ID exposes the Microsoft Graph API (list users, single endpoint for programmatic access) and supports automated multi-user processes like SCIM provisioning and Lifecycle Workflows that 'run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle,' which can act on many identities at once. However, the evidence never documents an explicit bulk/batch operation API (e.g., Graph $batch, CSV bulk import/export) or bulk admin UI for acting on many items simultaneously. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or bulk-edit UI documentation, evidence of bulk import/export tooling, and independent confirmation of bulk operation scale/limits.
